name: Spike grace: the one spike jump in a shaft
techNote: A 90-wide shaft (walls x -85 to -45 and 55 to 95, floor top y 0) with one spike on its floor: a 26x19 trigger (layer 6, spikeScript, the size of a single spike tile's collider in the game's Spikes composite), x -8 to 18, y 0 to 19. The hurtbox (40x54, x-15..x+25, y-27..y+27 facing right) can't miss it in a 90-wide shaft. The dot falls from y 150; spikeScript has no OnTriggerEnter2D, so the first overlapping tick (tick 17, y 44.9) is free, and it kills on the Stay that counts past graceFrames 1. The ground rays reach y-40 (22 down from y-18), so the fall is grounded on tick 19 and a buffered jump leaves on that tick, before the 2nd Stay: the hurtbox overlaps on ticks 17 (spike4 *0) and 18 (*1) only and the jump rises to the finish box over the spike. Of press ticks 0-24 only 13-19 make it (the jump buffer: up to 6 ticks before the landing tick); a press on tick 20 (late) lands and dies on the 2nd Stay.

ghosts.label: Spike grace: buffered jump, 2 ticks in the spike
Jump a tick after landing: 3rd tick in the spike, dies
